notes: Responses remote compaction (opaque server checkpoints) hooked into pi's normal compaction lifecycle. Upstream files are unchanged. Dropped: src/settings-menu.ts (TUI, @narumitw/pi-tui-kit) and the /codex-compact command (filtered by packages/backend/src/codex-compact.ts); src/index.ts. src/settings-menu.ts here is Argon's stand-in for a dynamic import. Settings come from Argon (ArgonSettings.remoteCompaction) through the factory's settingsRuntime option, so upstream settings.ts is kept but its file is never read. Upstream is not written for noUncheckedIndexedAccess: backend code imports entry.js / entry.d.ts (Argon's), the backend tsconfig excludes this folder, and ./tsconfig.json checks src with that flag off; entry.check.ts keeps entry.d.ts in sync.
